description:
### Release v3.16.1

- **Dual 18.0.3 & 18.5.4 Compatibility**: Added full 18.5.4 support alongside 18.0.3 for 25 core patches (Long-Press Editing Shortcuts, QWERTY flick uppercase, swipe down dismiss, cursor trackpad mode, clipboard limit & time retention, bluetooth mic, calculator, AI writing tools, etc.)
- **Backward Compatibility**: Preserved strict single-version stability for 18.0.3-exclusive aesthetic and layout patches.
- **Morphe Targeting**: Fully admitted 18.5.4.993608717-beta-arm64-v8a in patches-list.json.
